extracted.name: Smoky white bean & ricotta traybake
extracted.description: Make this bean and ricotta traybake using our pre-prepared roasted summer vegetable traybake. Serve al fresco with crusty bread for dipping and scooping
ingredient_lines: 700g jar white beans drained and rinsed
crusty bread and green salad, to serve
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Mix half the olive oil with the garlic, tomato purée, paprika, veg stock and thyme in a roasting tin. Stir in the roasted veg and beans, nestle the ricotta in the middle and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Season and roast for 30-35 mins until reduced and golden. Serve with crusty bread for dipping and a green salad in a lemony dressing.
